title: Cost Galaxy: token-level facet visualization, attribution & export pattern
creator: Ava Patel
description: Design and prototype a novel token-level cost analytics panel ("Cost Galaxy") for the Redwood Console. The Cost Galaxy is an interactive cluster map that surfaces cost attribution by token across message components (system, user, assistant), prompt templates, tool calls, and embeddings. It should make it easy to: 1) visually identify high-cost prompts or dialog fragments; 2) attribute cost across teams, routes, and models; 3) export line-item breakdowns for chargeback and downstream ETL; and 4) preview pricing impacts for rate-card changes, quantization, and batching policies. This ticket captures the UI patterns, export schema, accessibility considerations, and prototype assets for stakeholder review.

acceptance_criteria: Interactive Cost Galaxy renders initial aggregated view for selected time range (< 500ms for up to 1,000 token groups on staging),
Hovering a node surfaces: token_count, token_type_breakdown (system/user/assistant/tool), model_version, route, estimated_cost_usd, top-3 contributing prompts or messages
Filters available: date range, model family, route, team tag, prompt-template, SDK key; combination filters are persisted in URL for bookmarks
Export options: Line-item CSV (default), Parquet for analytics consumers, and Role-aware export presets that redact PII fields by default

CSV export columns: timestamp, route, team, sdk_key_hash, model_version, token_type_counts, total_tokens, unit_price_per_token_usd, estimated_cost_usd, prompt_template_id, message_ids_preview (first 200 chars), attribution_reason_tags
Pricing preview mode: user can toggle hypothetical rate-card (per-token band or per-message slab) and see instant aggregated delta estimates
decisions: Use client-side WebGL canvas for render of cluster map; fall back to SVG for small datasets to preserve accessibility semantics

Server will expose pre-aggregated token groups via new endpoint /api/v1/console/cost-galaxy/aggregates to avoid pulling raw message-level data for UI; export endpoint will stream line-items via signed URL for large requests
Default export redaction: message text removed unless user has export_role with 'billing_export' scope; include hash of sdk_key to join back to billing system
Pricing preview uses a deterministic mapping from model_family -> price_band so frontend can compute deltas without full backend recalculation for small previews
